claims.text: The proposed model outperforms baseline methods in training time, achieving its main task in under 30 hours compared to the baseline's six days.
The model exhibits better retrieval accuracy and cluster formation compared to baseline implementations, as shown in qualitative results.
The model's preprocessing algorithm allows for a larger effective dataset size compared to the baseline, enhancing its training effectiveness.
